text:
rachel: Noticed an uptick in invokes rejected for tool="email_sender" on route="stable-canary". Top reasons: "missing_field" and "parse_error". Any idea why?

jon: Can you share an example payload from the logs?

rachel: Pasted one from gzipped logs:
```json
{"req_id":"req-C23","tool":"email_sender","error":"missing_field","expected_fields":["to","subject","body"],"actual":{"to":"ops@acme.com","body":"hi"}}
```

priya: Ugh looks like the model variant used in the canary is omitting the subject for some prompt templates. We rolled that tag late last night.

leo: Do these rejects inflate customer-visible error rates or affect quotas? Support is getting pages.

billing-bot: Alert: customer_alerts spike for acct=acme-inc due to 502s (derived from invokes.rejects)

nina: We intentionally avoid counting validation rejects as billable tokens, but several dashboards downstream treat "invoke.rejects" as an error signal for SLA alerts. We need to fix the pipeline mapping.

jon: Immediate mitigation: can we route canary traffic through a shim that fills missing `subject` with "(no subject)" and tags the call `coerced_subject=true`? Then mark those events as soft rejects.

priya: That will avoid user-visible failures but could hide the model problem. Can we instead drain canary and route 100% to stable while we roll back?

rachel: Prefer shim+tag for 30m so support has less noise while we prepare rollback. Also need console filter to show both raw payloads and coerced ones.

leo: Telemetry changes: add fields `validation_reason`, `validation_action` (coerced/blocked), and `route_effective`. Sample full payloads at 5% to avoid PII leakage.

jon: Also add a time-based histogram `rejects_per_5m{route}` and an alert if rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m.

deploy-bot: deploy started: email-shim-coerce v1 -> stable-canary (started by jon) :truck:

priya: For rollout UX: can we have the console show an inline diff between expected schema and actual example, plus a one-click rollback to previous model tag? That would speed response.

nina: Agree. UX note: add a small "why this failed" card linking to common fixes (model tag rollback, filler shim, adapter patch).

leo: For quotas: billing team will patch alert routing so validation rejects don't create billing incidents. I'll coordinate.

rachel: After shim deploy, I'll run a quick sample query and share a list of affected customers: `select acct_id, count(*) from invokes where tool=\'email_sender\' and reject=true and ts > now() - interval \'1 hour\' group by acct_id;`

priya: Action items: 1) jon deploy shim to canary (done), 2) nina update console filters + sample rate, 3) leo update alert mapping, 4) rachel prepare rollback PR if model tag revert needed.

jon: CI green. Shim live on canary. Coercion tag added to traces.

rachel: Seeing immediate drop in 502 pages. Will watch metrics for 30m.

nina: Console filters added: `validation_action`, `validation_reason`, sample payloads at 5%. Added "how to fix" doc link.

leo: Billing alerts suppressed for validation-rejects for next 2 hours.

priya: We should add a pre-rollout schema check in the model push pipeline: run a small set of canonical prompts and assert `output_has(subject)==true` for email_sender-using prompts. I can submit a tiny pipeline job.

rachel: Thanks all. If regression persists after rollback we will open an incident. Otherwise I'll file a short RCA once metrics stabilize.
